apps.name: Notes for Claude
apps.tagline: Voice notes, a work list and ideas, sent to Claude in one tap
apps.description: Keep everything you want Claude to work on in one place on your phone. Type work to do or ideas, or tap the microphone and speak: your phone's speech to text turns voice notes into text (English, Urdu, Hindi or Punjabi). Every note has a topic, like Live TV or Website. When you're ready, tap Send to Claude: your ticked notes become one tidy message grouped by topic, copied and opened in Claude. Give a topic its own Claude project link and its notes go straight to that project chat. Sent notes are kept in a Sent list, and the app updates itself.
